encodes.text: A young female warrior with fair skin, dark black straight bangs framing her face, intense blue eyes gazing slightly off-camera with a confident smirk, wearing multiple silver piercings including one on her nose and ornate earrings featuring cross motifs; she has bold black brushstroke-style ink tattoo across her right cheekbone; dressed in form-fitting black leather armor with metallic rivets and zipper details covering her shoulders and upper torso, revealing intricate yellow-and-black traditional Japanese dragon tattoos wrapping around her left arm; holding a katana sword vertically positioned diagonally from bottom-left towards center-right, its hilt wrapped in textured black cordage with geometric cutouts and adorned with golden-yellow flame-like patterns near the scabbard’s base, tassel hanging below; close-up portrait framed tightly focusing on head-to-chest area, subject centered against a solid bright yellow studio backdrop creating high contrast; dramatic directional key lighting illuminating front-facing side of her face casting subtle shadows beneath jawline while strong backlight creates faint rim glow along hair strands and shoulder edges enhancing depth; photorealistic hyper-detailed digital painting rendered in ultra-sharp resolution with smooth surface textures mimicking real-world fabric and metal finishes under controlled studio illumination producing crisp highlights and natural shadow transitions; dominant palette consists of vivid yellow contrasting sharply with deep matte blacks accented by glowing gold elements conveying fierce determination and lethal elegance.
